title: rhododendron × norbitonense var. broughtonianum
intro: Rhododendron × norbitonense var. broughtonianum, commonly known as the Broughton's rhododendron, is a hybrid plant species in the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that may aid in wound healing and infection prevention. The therapeutic actions of Broughton's rhododendron include its antioxidant and anti-cancer properties, which may help protect against cell damage and certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
